compute.cost_note: local; opens every PDF and samples its first five pages with pypdf; incremental cache lets an interrupted run resume

do_not_use_when: the PDFs are remote URLs (use acquire_pdf_urls)
you want extracted text; this step only describes the library

examples.description: Inventory a PDF library into a private JSONL for review

artifacts: private pdf inventory JSONL (one row per PDF, under ai-prose-baselines-private/ unless --allow-public-output)

purpose: walk a local PDF library and emit a private JSONL inventory that classifies each PDF as text_extractable / image_only / mixed / corrupted from a first-five-pages text sample, with metadata quality and an estimated word count; the review surface the user filters and annotates before pdf_extract. Writes no cleaned text and no manifest entries.
use_when: you have a library of PDFs (papers, reports, books) and want to see what is extractable before adding any of it to the impostor pool
triaging which PDFs need OCR before running pdf_extract
